text:
taylor: hey folks, first day onboarding question. ran `rwd-kube login --env staging` and it printed a new context `redwood-staging-gke-03-taylor` but any kubectl command fails with `exec plugin failed to obtain credentials: exec plugin: invalid apiVersion \"client.authentication.k8s.io/v1beta1\"` — what did I break? :confused:
robin: welcome! that error usually means your kubeconfig has an exec plugin with an apiVersion your kubectl doesn't understand (or the opposite). can you paste the `yaml` snippet around the exec block? just `grep -n \"exec:\" -n ~/.kube/config -n && sed -n '1,120p' ~/.kube/config | sed -n '20,40p'` or simpler: `cat ~/.kube/config | sed -n '1,140p' | sed -n '/exec:/,+6p'`
taylor: pasted part below:
```
users:
- name: taylor@okta
  user:
    exec:
      apiVersion: client.authentication.k8s.io/v1beta1
      command: rwd-kube
      args:
        - get-token
        - --okta
```
robin: OK that is v1beta1. which kubectl version do you have? `kubectl version --client --short`
taylor: `Client Version: v1.28.0`
robin: v1.28 should support v1 apiVersion, but some kube client builds disabled beta acceptance. easiest fix: upgrade rwd-kube so it emits v1, or change kubectl to a compatible patch. try `brew update && brew upgrade rwd-kube` then re-run `rwd-kube login`.
devtools-bot: heads-up: deployed rwd-kube 0.9.3 two days ago which defaults exec apiVersion to `client.authentication.k8s.io/v1` for kubectl >=1.26. if you installed rwd-kube earlier you might have 0.8.x.
taylor: i installed via the curl script earlier today, looks like it pulled 0.8.7. brew shows 0.9.3 available. running upgrade now.
robin: after upgrade you may need to delete the old user entry in `~/.kube/config` or run `rwd-kube login --merge` again to ensure it rewrites the exec block. also watch out for KUBECONFIG env var if you have multiple files.
taylor: upgraded, re-ran login, `cat ~/.kube/config | sed -n '/taylor@okta/,+8p'` now shows `apiVersion: client.authentication.k8s.io/v1` and `kubectl get ns` works! thanks.
infra: quick note for the onboarding doc — add a troubleshooting line about exec plugin apiVersion mismatch and suggest `brew upgrade rwd-kube` or matching kubectl. also remind people to `unset KUBECONFIG` if they keep seeing old entries.
taylor: will add to my onboarding checklist. thanks for the quick help and the warm welcome! :tada:
